variants.name: 名前を全て書き、末尾の . を付けた形

www:
$TTL 300
$ORIGIN shop.example.
@     IN  SOA    ns1.shop.example. admin.shop.example. ( 2026101402 3600 900 604800 300 )
@     IN  NS     ns1.shop.example.
ns1   IN  A      203.0.113.53
@     IN  A      203.0.113.20   ; 店のページ
mail  IN  A      203.0.113.25   ; メールのサーバ
www.shop.example.   IN  CNAME  shop.example.
mail:
$TTL 300
$ORIGIN shop.example.
@     IN  SOA    ns1.shop.example. admin.shop.example. ( 2026101403 3600 900 604800 300 )
@     IN  NS     ns1.shop.example.
ns1   IN  A      203.0.113.53
@     IN  A      203.0.113.20   ; 店のページ
mail  IN  A      203.0.113.25   ; メールのサーバ
www.shop.example.   IN  CNAME  shop.example.
shop.example.  IN  MX  10  mail.shop.example.
